 Job | Sr. Naval Architect Superyachts | Amsterdam Area 
 Amsterdam, Nederland 
 Job description - Role: Senior Naval Architect - Project Engineer - Work location: Kaag or Amsterdam, the Netherlands - Start: ASAP - Duration: Long-term - Contract: Employment contract - Language: English - Focus: Naval architecture, hydrostatics, weight control, load line, tonnage, intact damage stability, inclining test, and large custom-built superyachts 
If your background is in naval architecture or marine engineering, this position gives you ownership of a broad technical scope within superyacht projects. You will review stability, weight, hydrostatics, performance and regulatory deliverables while working with an international, English-speaking project team. Relocation support is available in case you are moving to the Netherlands. 
Where You'll Work 
You will work at a Dutch shipyard specialising in fully custom-built superyachts between approximately 70 and 160 metres. Depending on the project, your workplace will be the yacht construction facility in Kaag or the modern shipyard in Amsterdam, where both newbuild and refit projects are completed. 
Reporting to the Lead Engineer, you will manage the naval architecture scope for one or more projects. Detailed calculations and analyses are generally prepared by external specialists. Your responsibility is to review and challenge these deliverables, coordinate the relevant technical interfaces, and maintain consistency across the complete naval architecture scope. 
What You'll Do - Take technical ownership of the naval architecture scope within your assigned superyacht project or projects. - Review and challenge deliverables covering stability, weight management, hydrostatics, vessel performance and watertight integrity. - Verify technical documentation related to structural fire protection, load line, tonnage and ...

Are you an experienced operator and would you like to work with fresh products in a clean and modern production environment? Apply now and join the team at an international production company in the Deurne region!

What will you do?
As an operator, you are responsible for a smooth production process. You make sure the machines are set correctly and that problems are solved quickly. You work closely with your team and guide colleagues when needed.

Your tasks will include:

- Setting up and starting production lines
- Monitoring the production process and product quality
- Solving small machine problems or calling the technical service
- Arranging the supply of raw materials
- Performing quality checks and HACCP registrations
- Supervising production workers on your line

As an operator:

- You have experience as an operator or in production
- You have a good level of Dutch or English
- You live in the region of Eindhoven, Helmond, Weert, Veldhoven, Deurne or Venray

Are you looking for an exciting logistics challenge at a major international company? If you’d like to work as a Warehouse Worker at GXO handling tasks like preparing, receiving, processing, and checking orders alongside your colleagues, then this vacancy is for you.

Your challenge:

As a Warehouse Worker at GXO, you may be deployed in various departments within the warehouse. Examples include inbound items, order picking, packing, inventory, or outbound items.

This ensures that no two days are the same and gives you the opportunity to learn a variety of tasks. Together with your colleagues, you ensure the logistics process runs smoothly and that orders reach the customer on time. You will work in a modern environment where teamwork, quality, and safety are top priorities.

No previous experience is required for this position. We welcome motivated candidates who are willing to learn and develop their skills on the job. You will start with comprehensive two-day training to familiarize yourself with all the tasks. This allows you to work with confidence and continue your professional development within the company.

- You are in good physical condition.
- You have a good command of English at a minimum B1 level, allowing you to understand
- instructions, communicate clearly, and handle basic professional conversations with confidence.
- You have your own transport and accommodation.
- You are eligible to apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) and can provide the required documentation when requested.
- You are available for work from Monday through Saturday and have a flexible attitude towards scheduling and working hours.
- You can work Full-time for 40 hours in a week

You will work a two-shift schedule:

- Week 1: 06:00 – 14:45
- Week 2: 15:15 – 00:00

For our client Brewery Bavaria, we are looking for motivated machine operators who are ready to work in a 3-shift system. Do you already have experience in production or logistics and want to take the next step in your career? Or are you completely new but eager to learn a skilled trade? In both cases, we’d love to meet you!

As a machine operator in Bavaria’s bottling plant, every shift begins with a short team meeting where you and your colleagues discuss the latest updates: ongoing orders, open tasks, and any technical issues. After that, you head to your workstation for a dynamic and varied workday.

Your tasks include:

- Troubleshooting and solving malfunctions
- Rebuilding machines together with colleagues
- Performing maintenance work
- Refilling cardboard and plastic supplies
- Carrying out quality checks. 
- And, of course, keeping your workplace clean and safe

New to the job? No problem! You’ll receive thorough training from your team leader and experienced instructors. Most roles have a 4-week onboarding program to get you fully up to speed with the bottling plant and its machinery.

Shift schedule:

- Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00
- Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00
- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00

- Full-time available in 3 shifts;
- Good command of Dutch and/or English;
- Experience in production or eager to learn.

Are you looking for a side job that you can combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for a part-time order picker for both the morning and evening shifts. These shifts alternate weekly. In this role, you ensure that all orders are prepared correctly, completely, and on time for shipment.

As an order picker, you start by collecting orders in the warehouse. Using a scanner and headset, you gather the correct products while carefully checking quantities and items.

Are all products complete? Then you ensure careful and safe packaging. You select the right packaging materials, label the order correctly, and perform a final check before it is shipped.

You will work in a two-shift system: a morning shift from 07:00 to 16:00 and an evening shift from 16:00 to 00:00, alternating weekly. This means you work the early shift one week and the late shift the next.

Additionally, you are willing to work one Saturday per month from 08:00 to 16:00.

- Available at least 2 working days per week
- Able to work in a two-shift system
- Flexible, including one Saturday every four weeks
- Physically capable of active work
- A team player who speaks Dutch or English
- Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required

Do you enjoy working with your hands and with different materials?

Composite material is made up of multiple materials bonded or laminated together. Think panels, interior parts, and structural aircraft components. As a Composite Shop Worker, you'll repair and maintain these parts. You're comfortable working with a range of materials: composite, plastic, metal, and interior materials. You carry out repairs according to fixed technical specifications and work instructions, working precisely with professional tools in a hangar or workshop environment. You'll also identify and resolve damage to interior and composite components, a role that combines the best of sheet metal work and interior work.

- You have experience working with different materials, or a relevant technical education (e.g. in sheet metal work, composites, or interior construction)
- You have a precise, careful way of working
- You're willing to (further) build your technical expertise
- You speak good English (technical drawings are all in English)
- You're comfortable working with computers; administration is also part of the job
- You're willing to occasionally work evenings and weekends (on average once every 4 weeks - after 8 months from starting)

As a Reachtruck/or Forklift driver at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you will make sure that all products get to the right place. You work in a multinational team where you will quickly feel at home.

In the warehouse you are constantly on the move. You load and unload trucks with precision and speed. With your reach truck or forklift you drive through the aisles to pick or put away products. You stack items neatly, so everything is stored efficiently.

Cooperation is important in this job. You consult with colleagues to make sure the work runs smoothly. Together you ensure that all orders are ready for shipment on time.

You work 37.5 hours per week in two shifts: from 06:00 to 14:30 or from 14:30 to 23:00. 

Are you ready to get started in this modern distribution center? Then apply now and become part of the Samsung SDS team!

You enjoy being active and like variety in your work. As a reach truck or forklift driver at Samsung SDS, you'll make sure everything gets to the right place.

What you bring:

- You speak good English. So you can easily communicate with your colleagues.
- You have a good physical condition. The work can be heavy at times.
- You are available full time and can work both shifts 
- You have your own accommodation and transport

It is an advantage if you can also work on weekends. This way you help the team when it is extra busy.

For a modern warehouse facility in Tilburg, we are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Warehouse Operative with reach truck experience. In this full-time day shift position, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient warehouse operations. 

Responsibilities

- Sort goods based on item numbers, batch numbers, and lot numbers.
- Process inventory accurately using a handheld scanner. 
- Store incoming goods in the correct warehouse locations.
- Pick, prepare, and stage orders for shipment.
- Operate a reach truck safely and efficiently. 
- Support additional warehouse activities when required. 

- A valid reach truck certificate is required.
- Available full-time in day shifts.
- Good command of Dutch and/or English.

Are you the new forklift hero of Bavaria?
At Bavaria, we are looking for enthusiastic forklift drivers to join our logistics team. In this full-time role, you play a key part in ensuring that our logistics processes run smoothly every day. Do you want to work for one of the world’s most iconic beer brands in a dynamic and team-oriented environment? Then keep reading!

What will you do?
As a forklift driver, you play an essential role in our warehouse operations. You ensure that pallets filled with our beverages are placed in the right location in a safe and structured way. Once production is completed, you take over and carefully move goods throughout the warehouse.
You will also support export activities, making sure our products are prepared correctly and reach international customers safely and on time.

Your daily tasks

- Using an on-board computer, you know exactly which pallets need to be moved and where they should go.
- You prepare goods for shipment to customers around the world.
- You work closely with your colleagues and always maintain a safe working environment.
- You get the chance to learn different areas of the warehouse, with the order pool as your fixed base.

Working hours & flexibility
At Bavaria, we work with both day shifts and a 3-shift system. Flexibility is important:

Day shifts

- 08:00 – 16:30
- 09:30 – 18:00

3-shift system

- Early shift: 06:00 – 14:00
- Late shift: 14:00 – 22:00
- Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00 (always in blocks of 4 nights)

This way, we offer a varied but structured work schedule where your contribution truly makes a difference.

*This is a temporary position lasting approximately till April 2027.

- You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate;
- You are fluent in either Dutch or English;
- You are willing to work in shift patterns, including day shifts.

Are you a hard worker who feels at home in a dynamic logistics environment? For our client in Son & Breugel, we are looking for a Logistics Employee who is ready to roll up their sleeves. In this role, you will work together with an enthusiastic team and help ensure that the logistics process runs smoothly. The work is divided across different teams: Crossdock (incoming and outgoing goods), Packing (reach truck) and Pick & Pack (order picking).

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you will be responsible for various tasks within the warehouse. You will ensure that orders are processed correctly and that the logistics process runs efficiently.

Your tasks will include:

- Picking orders
- Packing and preparing orders for shipment
- Checking shipments for accuracy and completeness
- Loading and unloading goods
- Re-stacking and processing incoming goods
- Working with an EPT and reach truck
- Maintaining a safe and clean working environment

You will work day shifts, with working hours from 08:00 to 17:00.

- You already have some experience in logistics
- You are in possession of an EPT certificate and know how to work with it properly
- You have a valid reach truck certificate
- You are proactive, hands-on and work accurately
- You speak and understand both English well
